rules.text: Stalk = place working limit/conditional orders immediately (not watchlist-only). Fill moves to positions/; invalidate cancels order.

layers.orders: working limit / buy-stop / conditional — not filled
layers.watchlist: observe only, no working order (deferred names)

rules.text: Stalk lifetime: cancel working order on (1) structure invalidation on the ticket, (2) 5 US sessions without fill (default), (3) earnings−1 session expire if set, (4) thesis dead / Setup drop, (5) price left zone — do not chase-raise limit. Regime is reference: Deep Bear/0% keeps paper_probe working orders unless kill/expire. Turn not Favor for that name's sleeve (Favor→Neutral/Avoid or Focus Short hits sleeve) → cancel that name's working order. Regime improve does not auto size-up; next stalks may drop paper_probe when exposure allows. No silent stop/zone edits; session-close confirmation unless gap through invalidation. Concrete left-zone: also see `limit-away-5pct-cancel-v1` (Close ≥5% past limit → auto cancel).
Watchlist = Second brain stalk names (e.g. CRL+DK). Journal = after real execute: track SL, targets, exposure, marks. OPS lines only for working/skip/rules.

Per-name notional cap = 20% of equity ($20,000 on $100k). shares = floor(R / stop%); notional = shares × entry; if notional > 20% equity, resize shares = floor(0.20 × equity / entry) and record effective_R. No slippage adjustment on paper fills (Justin 2026-10-16).

Every Second brain stalk gets a Logic_Audit row from list day (box logic-audit/<TICKER>.json + Sheet tab Logic_Audit). Track pass updates T+1/T+3/T+5 closes+returns, MFE/MAE vs baseline_close (prior US session close). Grades: 追蹤中 / 精準到價 / 假突破止蝕 / 未到價過期 / 結構作廢. Independent of paper P&L. Reconcile: if closed audits n<30, state 樣本不足 and do not draw setup/exit conclusions from grades. Fill sets filled=Y; cancel/expire sets grade.

IF entry price is BELOW the 9EMA at entry (entry_below_9ema=true), THEN do NOT exit on session close below 9EMA until 3 full US sessions have elapsed AFTER the entry session. Convention: entry_session_date = US session of fill = session 0; sessions_held = count of completed US session closes with date > entry_session_date; EMA9_EXIT is suppressed while sessions_held < 3; first eligible check is when sessions_held reaches 3 (close of the 3rd session after entry). IF entry is AT or ABOVE 9EMA at entry → no grace; normal close-below-9EMA full exit from the first post-entry mark onward. Hard SL UNAFFECTED: session close below stop / gap through stop still full exit immediately. Soft rules unchanged: trim consider (+3 sessions), time stop ask-Justin, thesis/structure invalid.

defaults.compare: entry_price < ema9_at_entry → entry_below_9ema true; entry >= ema9 → false

rules.superseded_note: Justin widened grace to ALL positions first 3 sessions (not only entry_below_9ema).

rules.text: Working LIMIT buy/sell orders use ONE price (limit_price), not a range (no limit_low/limit_high bands). Fill rule: session Low <= limit_price (buy) or High >= limit_price (sell) → fill at limit_price with no slippage. Conditional reclaim/hold gates are separate order_types and must not be disguised as a limit range. Historical filled zone orders (e.g. CRL limit_zone 300–306) stay as-is in ledger history; new/amended working orders must be single-price.

Every stalk / working order / position plan MUST be concrete numbers, not vague language. Required fields: single entry `limit_price` (not a range; also `limit-single-price-v1`), `stop` (hard number), `shares`, `r_usd` (R$), hard `invalidation` level or condition, `max_stalk_sessions` (default 5 per stalk-lifetime-v1). Forbidden as fill gates: vague reclaim wording, "hold EMA" / "reclaim and hold", zone/range limits (limit_low–limit_high), and "consider" used as an entry/fill trigger. Time stop still asks Justin; trim 1/3+BE at sessions_held=3 is AUTO (`trim-1-3-be-auto-v1`) — but entry / stop / size / invalidation must always be numbers before a working order is placed. Missing any required number → skip + say what is missing; do not invent.

ALL open positions get a 9EMA exit grace for the first 3 US sessions after entry. Convention: entry_session_date = US session of fill = session 0; sessions_held = count of completed US session closes with date > entry_session_date; EMA9_EXIT is suppressed while sessions_held < 3; first eligible check is when sessions_held reaches 3 (close of the 3rd session after entry). Applies regardless of whether entry was above or below 9EMA at fill (entry_below_9ema is informational only, no longer a grace gate). Hard SL UNAFFECTED: session close below stop / gap through stop still full exit immediately. Soft: time stop ask-Justin, thesis/structure invalid. Trim 1/3+BE at sessions_held=3 is AUTO (`trim-1-3-be-auto-v1`, Justin 2026-10-22).

After every US swing sim post-close track pass, sync TradingView watchlist **us shortlist** (id `351605193`) to match the paper book. INCLUDE (union): all open positions under positions/ + all working orders under orders/ + active watchlist stalks under watchlist/ (exclude FORMAT/_TEMPLATE/_index). REMOVE: any symbol currently on the TV list that is no longer in that union. Symbol format EXCHANGE:TICKER (known map: NYSE:CRL, NYSE:DK, NASDAQ:FRSH, NASDAQ:LIFE, NASDAQ:AUGO; resolve unknown via mcp-tv-search-symbols stock). Tools: user-Tradingview-xai mcp-watchlist-get-watchlist → add via mcp-watchlist-add-to-watchlist → remove via mcp-watchlist-remove-from-watchlist. Do not sync closed/cancelled/expired names. Run as final step after Sheet + Drive sync. Journal one OPS line with added/removed (or 'no-op').

When sessions_held first reaches 3 (entry session=0; same convention as 9ema-grace-3sessions-v2), AUTO trim 1/3 and move stop to breakeven (BE=entry). Do NOT ask Justin. Timing: on the post-close track pass that first sets sessions_held>=3, queue a pending market_open_sell for the NEXT US cash open (sell floor(shares/3) @ Open; remain shares; stop→entry). Fill on that open print (TV MCP session Open; no slippage invent). Mark position.trim_1_3_done=true so it only fires once. Shares: trim=floor(shares/3), remain=shares-trim. After fill: journal TRIM_1_3; recompute r_usd on remain vs BE (≈0 risk from entry); update cash. Hard SL / EMA9 / thesis / time-stop unchanged. If already trimmed or pending_instruction TRIM_1_3_BE exists → skip. Justin 2026-10-22:「呢個當必做，下次唔使問」— supersedes soft 'consider trim' ask.

defaults.supersedes: soft consider trim ask at +3 sessions

rules.text: On each post-close track, for every WORKING limit order: compare session Close (TV MCP) to limit_price. If price is ≥5% away on the wrong side of the limit, AUTO cancel — do NOT ask Justin. Buy limit: cancel when Close ≥ limit_price × 1.05 (ran above / left zone). Sell limit: cancel when Close ≤ limit_price × 0.95. Metric = session close only (not H/L). Journal CANCEL + free R reserved; Logic_Audit grade 未到價過期; remove from TV us shortlist. Does not change Hard SL / fill rules / stalk max-5. Justin 2026-10-22 after LIFE:「下次自己做，排limit 5% 外就取消得；計收市價」.

For any position that has completed trim-1-3-be (trim_1_3_done=true) AND sessions_held >= 5 (or any already-trimmed name at/after the 5-session time-stop window): do NOT ask time-stop; HOLD until Hard SL / BE stop hit (session close below stop) OR close below 9EMA (EMA9_EXIT, grace already expired). Applies to CRL / FRSH / HAFN now and future. Justin 2026-10-30:「所有已滿5日，trim左，繼續持有unless touch breakeven stop or close below 9ema」.

When a working LIMIT is marketable at the Open (or fill print), fill at the BETTER price vs limit — never worse (no adverse slippage). Buy limit: if Open (or executable print) < limit_price → fill @ that lower price (NOT at limit). Sell limit (mirror): if Open (or print) > limit_price → fill @ that higher price. If Open is on the unfavorable side of limit but the limit is still touched (buy: Low<=limit; sell: High>=limit) → fill @ limit_price per limit-single-price-v1. Justin 2026-10-30:「CRWD 因為limit at 260.25, must be better filled at 254.335… If sell, same logic, 調返轉」. Example applied: CRWD L260.25 → Open 254.335 fill.

defaults.overrides_when_open_better: limit-single-price-v1 fill-at-limit only when Open is not better

rules.text: At OPEN Soft Final: before placing a working limit, check session Close (or last mark Close). Buy: if Close ≥ limit_price × 1.05 → place OBSERVE only (watchlist), never working. Sell: if Close ≤ limit_price × 0.95 → OBSERVE only. Aligns place-time with `limit-away-5pct-cancel-v1` (track still AUTO cancels working that later leave the band). Do not chase-raise the limit to stay inside away.

rules.source: W44 execution-eval + chat t74u; extends better-price-v1
rules.text: On better-price fill (Open/print better than limit per `better-price-v1`): AUTO recompute stop and R$. Prefer same $ risk from original plan: plan_$risk = |plan_entry − plan_stop|; new_stop = entry − plan_$risk (long) or entry + plan_$risk (short). If plan_$risk unavailable, keep same stop% vs new entry. Then R$ = shares × |entry − stop|. Soft Final / journal / position file must show both new stop and R$. Never leave plan stop glued to old limit when fill price moved.

Before OPEN Soft Final locks working orders: require (1) Σ working notional ≤ available cash AND (2) open_count + count(working that could fill) ≤ 7. If either fails: keep only highest-priority ≤N names that fit both gates; demote the rest to OBSERVE in the **same** Soft Final. No later cash-cap / slot patch after Soft Final.
Every Soft Final header must include crowding one-liner: OPEN x/7 · cash · R reserved · working notional. Missing any field → Soft Final incomplete (do not claim Done).

Soft Final void / reverse / re-OPEN that voids a prior Soft Final for the same bar-date requires Justin or 總指揮 AUTHORIZE. Default: one Soft Final per bar-date unless authorized. Do not silently void and rewrite book state.

After fill / cancel / stop-recalc that changes Positions or Dashboard: Soft Final (or track Done) only after Sheet Positions + Dashboard readback matches ledger. If mismatch → explicit FAIL (do not claim Done). No change → Sheet rebuild may SKIP with note.

Do not re-OPEN the same ticker within ~3 US sessions of cancel / observe / fill-exit unless (a) new limit is inside the away band (Close within 5% of L) AND (b) size-down to paper_probe or ≤0.5R. Else OBSERVE / SKIP.

Every Sunday: write `/workspace/us-swing-sim/weekly/YYYY-Www-execution-eval.md` with four blocks — (1) planned vs actual (2) failed / reverse (3) flaws / root cause (4) improvement plan. Paper execution only.
